title: SchedulingConstraint - Data API
description: Represents scheduling constraints on each service resource. This object is available in API version 50.0 and later.

LastReferencedDate.description: The date when the scheduling constraint was last modified. Its label in the user interface is Last Modified Date.

LastViewedDate.description: The date when the scheduling constraint was last viewed.

MaxNonstandardShiftsPerMonth.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MaxNonstandardShiftsPerMonth.description: The maximum number of non-standard shifts assigned to an agent in a month. This field is available in API version 54.0 and later.

MaxShiftsPerDay.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MaxShiftsPerDay.description: The maximum number of shifts an agent can have in a day.

MaxShiftsPerMonth.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MaxShiftsPerMonth.description: The maximum number of shifts an agent can have in a month.

MaxShiftsPerWeek.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MaxShiftsPerWeek.description: The maximum number of shifts an agent can have in a week.

MaxWorkingHoursPerDay.description: The maximum number of hours an agent can have in a day.

MaxWorkingHoursPerMonth.description: The maximum number of hours an agent can have in a month.

MaxWorkingHoursPerWeek.description: The maximum number of hours an agent can have in a week.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The owner of the scheduling constraint. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

RestTimeMinutes.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
RestTimeMinutes.description: The minimum rest time, in minutes, between an agent’s consecutive shifts. This field is available in API versions 56.0 and later.
